# Vendored CSL styles and locale

These files are copied unmodified from the Citation Style Language project and are
embedded in `src/bibliography/styles.generated.ts` by `scripts/build-styles.ts`.

| File | Source | Title |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apa.csl` | https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles/blob/master/apa.csl | APA Style 7th edition |
| `modern-language-association.csl` | https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles/blob/master/modern-language-association.csl | MLA Handbook 9th edition (in-text citations) |
| `chicago-author-date.csl` | https://github.com/citation-style-language/styles/blob/master/chicago-author-date.csl | Chicago Manual of Style 18th edition (author-date) |
| `locales-en-US.xml` | https://github.com/citation-style-language/locales/blob/master/locales-en-US.xml | English (US) locale |

Retrieved 2026-11-24. Authors and contributors are listed in each file's `<info>`
block.
